summary: When a BGP peer or a link fails, alternate paths should be used quickly. This informational RFC gives a basic methodology for benchmarking BGP data-plane convergence, so that vendors and operators can measure and compare how fast a router switches traffic to backup paths.

eli5.summary: When a road closes, how fast do drivers find a new route? This gives a fair way to time it so different routers can be compared.

questions: how to measure bgp data plane convergence
